    model.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor(thermo_method=thermo_method, thermo_data=thermo_data))

    model.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(map_data=LPT2269, 
                                            thermo_method=thermo_method, thermo_data=thermo_data))
    
    # Nozzle (CD)
    model.add_subsystem('nozz', pyc.Nozzle(thermo_method=thermo_method, thermo_data=thermo_data))

    model.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
    model.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')

    model.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'nozz.Fl_I')
